_: Kling V3. Four quality tiers plus a 4K route and motion control. Prices are fal's own published per-second rates, which differ per tier and again by whether audio is generated; genmedia reports a flat $0.14 for all of them and is wrong about five of the six.

fal-ai/kling-video/v3/standard/text-to-v.displayName: Kling V3 Standard Text to Video
fal-ai/kling-video/v3/standard/text-to-v.description: Kling's base tier, writing a clip from a sentence. Audio is generated with it unless you turn it off, and costs more when it is.

pricing.note: fal publishes $0.084 per second of output with audio off and $0.126 with it on, and $0.154 when voice control is used. Priced from the audio-on default and scaled down when it is off. genmedia reports a flat $0.14 for every Kling V3 tier, which is wrong for five of the six.

fal-ai/kling-video/v3/standard/image-to-.displayName: Kling V3 Standard Image to Video
fal-ai/kling-video/v3/standard/image-to-.description: Kling's base tier, animating a still. Give it a start frame, or a start and an end to move between them.

pricing.note: fal publishes $0.084 per second of output with audio off and $0.126 with it on. Priced from the audio-on default and scaled down when it is off.

fal-ai/kling-video/v3/pro/text-to-video.displayName: Kling V3 Pro Text to Video
fal-ai/kling-video/v3/pro/text-to-video.description: The tier most people want: noticeably steadier motion than standard for a third more per second.

pricing.note: fal publishes $0.112 per second of output with audio off and $0.168 with it on, and $0.196 when voice control is used. Priced from the audio-on default and scaled down when it is off.

fal-ai/kling-video/v3/pro/image-to-video.displayName: Kling V3 Pro Image to Video
fal-ai/kling-video/v3/pro/image-to-video.description: Pro tier from a still. Takes a start frame and optionally an end one, and can be given a cast of elements to keep consistent.

pricing.note: fal publishes $0.112 per second of output with audio off and $0.168 with it on. Priced from the audio-on default and scaled down when it is off.

fal-ai/kling-video/v3/turbo/standard/tex.displayName: Kling V3 Turbo Standard Text to Video
fal-ai/kling-video/v3/turbo/standard/tex.description: The fast route at the base tier. One flat rate whatever the settings.

pricing.note: fal publishes a flat $0.112 per second of output. genmedia reports $0.14.

fal-ai/kling-video/v3/turbo/standard/ima.displayName: Kling V3 Turbo Standard Image to Video
fal-ai/kling-video/v3/turbo/standard/ima.description: The fast route at the base tier, animating a still.

pricing.note: fal publishes a flat $0.112 per second of output. genmedia reports $0.14.

fal-ai/kling-video/v3/turbo/pro/text-to-.displayName: Kling V3 Turbo Pro Text to Video
fal-ai/kling-video/v3/turbo/pro/text-to-.description: Pro quality on the fast route. Flat rate, no audio surcharge.

pricing.note: fal publishes a flat $0.14 per second of output.

fal-ai/kling-video/v3/turbo/pro/image-to.displayName: Kling V3 Turbo Pro Image to Video
fal-ai/kling-video/v3/turbo/pro/image-to.description: Pro quality on the fast route, animating a still.

pricing.note: fal publishes a flat $0.14 per second of output.

fal-ai/kling-video/v3/4k/text-to-video.description: Four thousand pixels wide, at three times the price of pro. Worth it for a finished shot, not for finding one.

pricing.note: fal publishes a flat $0.42 per second of output, audio on or off. genmedia reports $0.14.

fal-ai/kling-video/v3/4k/image-to-video.description: Four thousand pixels wide from a still, at three times the price of pro.

pricing.note: fal publishes a flat $0.42 per second of output, audio on or off. genmedia reports $0.14.

fal-ai/kling-video/v3/standard/motion-co.description: Copies the movement of one clip onto a character of your own. Give it the motion to follow and the figure that should follow it.

pricing.note: fal publishes $0.126 per second of output. genmedia reports $0.14. It has no length control: the clip is as long as the motion it is copying, so the hold assumes Kling's ten second ceiling and settle returns the rest.

fal-ai/kling-video/v3/pro/motion-control.description: Motion transfer at the pro tier, for when the copied movement has to hold up close.

pricing.note: fal publishes $0.168 per second of output. genmedia reports $0.14. It has no length control: the clip is as long as the motion it is copying, so the hold assumes Kling's ten second ceiling and settle returns the rest.
